facts.fact: Dautre 施法带众人瞬移，一行人直接出现在 Mercy 医院的等候区，Adam 夸他「smooth as glass（稳如玻璃）」。
Adam 拧开手中罐子的盖子，里面的灵魂像一只虹彩蜜蜂般窜进走廊。
facts.anchor: Adam unscrewed the lid of the one he held, and the soul within darted down the hall like an iridescent honeybee.

facts.fact: Tristan 苏醒了，眨着棕色的眼睛、睡意惺忪地向护士提问。
facts.anchor: Tristan was awake, blinking brown eyes and asking the nurse sleepy questions.

facts.fact: Adam 清点罐子：Cole 备好了十二个，他在音乐会上的手笔抓到了六枚灵魂。
facts.anchor: Cole had prepped twelve. His work at the concert had caught six souls.

facts.fact: Adam 推断别处必定还有更多罐子，而且很可能掌握在别人手中。
facts.anchor: There had to be more jars somewhere else, and likely in someone else’s control.

facts.fact: Adam 说他会把 Cole 带回家、问一些问题，然后放他自由。
facts.anchor: “Take him home, ask him some questions, then set him free.”

facts.fact: Adam 打电话到 Wilcox 的应答服务，接线女子以冷淡的口气称呼他「Binder 先生」。
facts.anchor: “Mr. Binder,” the woman at Wilcox’s answering service greeted in a clipped tone.

facts.fact: Wilcox 评价 Cole：天赋不足，但很会说话、是个真正的煽动家；自己手里还有其他工具可用。
facts.anchor: “Exactly. Not enough raw talent, but he was a good talker, a real rabble rouser. Still, I have several other tools in my box.”
